task.source_name: Ripple issue-linked change dataset (record instance-00010; used for candidate discovery and cross-check only)
task.issue_text_source: ASF Jira REST API v2 issue IVY-1028 fields created,summary,description; timestamp and original request checked 2026-10-25; https://issues.apache.org/jira/rest/api/2/issue/IVY-1028?fields=created,summary,description
task.selection_decision: Selected for a one-task pilot after verifying the official Jira creation timestamp precedes the target, the target's first parent equals the recorded parent, and the complete parent-to-target Git diff path set. Evaluation label is every changed path in the target patch, including CHANGES.txt; Ripple impact-set-files is separately recorded metadata and is not used as ground truth.
cleaning_decisions: Use original issue summary plus cleaned opening technical problem statement; omit quoted mail headers, contact addresses, and follow-up discussion.
Ground truth is exact Git diff path set from parent to target; do not substitute Ripple impact-set-files.
No target diff/body, commit message, changed paths, or post-target repository content is included in predictor input.

allowed: candidate paths selected from the parent tree (production Java, tests, non-Java text files; label-free rule)
predictor_input_policy.constraint_type: candidate-list prompt constraint; strict validation still enforced after generation

baselines.seed_selection: first deterministic lexical source rank from request text against parent snapshot

predictions.rationale: The change involves modifying the resolver configuration, and IBiblioResolver is likely to be affected.
ResolveEngine is responsible for managing the resolution process, which could be impacted by changes in resolver configuration.
IvyNode represents a module in the dependency graph, and changes in resolver configuration might affect how nodes are processed.
VisitNode is used during the resolution process to track visited nodes, and changes in resolver configuration might affect this process.
ResolveData holds the state of the resolution process, and changes in resolver configuration might affect how this data is managed.
ResolvedModuleRevision represents a resolved module version, and changes in resolver configuration might affect how these revisions are resolved.
IvyNodeEviction handles the eviction of nodes during the resolution process, and changes in resolver configuration might affect this process.
BasicResolver is a base class for resolvers, and changes in resolver configuration might affect how this class is used.
ChainResolver chains multiple resolvers, and changes in resolver configuration might affect how this class is used.
AbstractPatternsBasedResolver is a base class for resolvers that use patterns, and changes in resolver configuration might affect how this class is used.

limitations: A single model call is one sample; repeated calls can differ in lower ranks.
Changed-path labels are not a complete oracle for every file potentially affected.
Issue cleaning decisions are recorded in the task manifest.
C0_CONSTRAINED is a candidate-list prompt condition, not a hard decoding constraint; invalid paths are still rejected.
